name: Pi: The Open-Source AI Coding Agent You Probably Haven't Tried Yet - DEV Community
description: If you've been following the AI coding agent space, you've likely heard of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Codex. But there's a fast-moving open-source alternative sitting at over 46,000 GitHub stars that deserves a serious look: pi, from earendil-works/pi.
